title: 20d momentum reverses at 5d horizon inside the shortlist
thesis: Layer-2's momentum input (25% weight at launch) carried Spearman IC -0.22 (t -4.4) vs 5d forward alpha within the top-35. Zeroing momentum and redistributing to volume improved 5d alpha in both test windows (IS -0.93 vs -1.97; OOS +0.11 vs -0.88). Consistent with Jegadeesh short-term reversal.

title: 20d-low proximity (rebound) adds alpha on top of momentum-zero config
thesis: low20_ratio = min(close,20d)/close was HEALTHY in both bench windows (IC +0.077). Added as cross-sectional percentile at weight 0.15: beat the momentum-zero champion in BOTH windows (IS -0.17 vs -0.93; OOS +0.42 vs +0.11) with lower half-to-half variance.

title: Volume churn (vstd20) and price-volume correlation (pv_corr_20d) predict 5d underperformance
thesis: Both HEALTHY negative in the two-window bench (IC -0.079 / -0.075) but did not beat the champion when added to the composite in the extended sweep. Wired into the funnel at weight 0.0; persisted every scan for nightly measurement; promote only if a future sweep clears the gates.
